description: a is a permuted view in f16: [3, 2, 4] @ [4, 3].
notes: a is fed as a permuted view: uploaded with its dims reversed, then permuted back. out is torch.matmul in f64, rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's BLAS kernel; torch.matmul in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
